ma.connectSocket(Object object)

Create a WebSocket connection.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes WSS API address of the developer server.
header Object No HTTP header. Referer cannot be set in the header.
protocols Array No Sub-protocol array.
tcpNoDelay Boolean false No TCP_NODELAY setting during TCP connection setup, which is supported by Android but not iOS.
perMessageDeflate Boolean false No Whether to enable compression extension, which is supported by Android but not iOS.
timeout Number No Timeout duration, in milliseconds.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

    ma.connectSocket({
      url: 'wss://example.com',
      header:{
         'content-type': 'application/json'
      },
      protocols: ['protocol1']
    })

Bug & Tip

  1. tip: Currently, the security domain is not verified. You are advised to use WSS.
  2. tip: Currently wss does not have certificate verification, and it is necessary to provide certificate verification capabilities in the MacleEventHandler interface implementation.
